title: SPECTRA: Adaptive Execution of Speculative Decoding on a Runtime-Reconfigurable Tiled Architecture
abstract: arXiv:2609.24847v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM inference on edge devices is constrained by computational and memory resources, making efficient autoregressive decoding challenging. Speculative decoding alleviates this bottleneck by generating tokens with a smaller draft model and verifying multiple tokens in parallel with a batched target model pass. However, verification introduces a runtime-dependent intermediate regime between memory-bound general matrix-vector (GEMV) operations in decoding and compute-bound general matrix-matrix (GEMM) operations in prefill, as its arithmetic intensity varies with speculation length and acceptance rate. We present SPECTRA, a runtime-reconfigurable tiled architecture that sustains high utilization across the full speculative decoding pipeline. Within each tile, the compute engine switches between systolic execution for GEMMs and vector-lane execution for GEMVs. Across tiles, SPECTRA dynamically adapts computation parallelism by selecting til

translated_title: SPECTRA：在运行时可重构的瓦片式架构上自适应执行投机解码
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.24847v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：边缘设备上的大语言模型（LLM）推理受计算与内存资源的限制，使得高效的自回归解码面临挑战。投机解码通过使用较小的草稿模型生成token，并以批量目标模型单次前向传递并行验证多个token，从而缓解了这一瓶颈。然而，验证过程引入了一种依赖运行时的中间计算状态，介于解码阶段受内存限制的通用矩阵向量运算（GEMV）与预填充阶段受计算限制的通用矩阵矩阵运算（GEMM）之间，因为其算术强度会随投机长度和接受率而变化。我们提出了SPECTRA，这是一种运行时可重构的瓦片式架构，能够在整个投机解码流水线中保持高利用率。在每个瓦片内部，计算引擎可在面向GEMM的脉动阵列执行与面向GEMV的向量通道执行之间切换。在瓦片之间，SPECTRA通过选择瓦片（数量）动态调整计算并行度……
tldr: SPECTRA提出一种运行时可重构的瓦片式架构，通过瓦片内在脉动阵列与向量通道执行模式间切换、瓦片间动态调整并行度，使投机解码在GEMV与GEMM之间的中间计算状态下仍能保持高硬件利用率。
en_tdlr: SPECTRA is a runtime-reconfigurable tiled architecture that sustains high utilization across the full speculative decoding pipeline by switching between systolic GEMM and vector-lane GEMV execution within each tile and dynamically adapting parallelism across tiles.
